name: Uber-Like Ride-Hailing Platform API
description:
REST API for an Uber-like ride-hailing platform. Supports fare estimation, ride requests, driver matching, trip monitoring, PIN verification, route management, ratings, and real-time location tracking.

## Versioning

The API is versioned via the URL path. The current stable version is v1.

| Version | Base Path | Status  |
|---------|-----------|-------  |
| v1      | /api/v1   | Current |

All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/{version}`. When a new version is released, older versions will continue to work.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a valid session. Authenticate via `POST /auth/login` to receive a bearer token. Include it in subsequent requests:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Rate Limiting

Requests are rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per user. Unauthenticated requests are limited to 10/min by IP.

| Header                | Description                    |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------|
| X-RateLimit-Remaining | Requests left this window      |
| X-RateLimit-Reset     | Seconds until window reset     |

## Errors

All errors return a consistent JSON body:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "message": "The requested resource does not exist.",
    "status": 404,
    "timestamp": "2026-02-28T10:15:30Z",
    "requestId": "req-uuid-here"
  }
}
```


### WebSocket Integration (Driver Dispatch)

Real-time ride dispatch notifications are delivered to drivers via WebSocket.

**Initiating the connection:** When the driver opens their app, the client calls `GET /drivers/{driverId}/ws-token` to obtain a short-lived WebSocket authentication token.  
The driver app then connects using:

```
wss://api.uber-platform.com/api/v1/ws?token=<ws_token>
```

**Server → Driver Events:**

```json
{
  "type": "RIDE_DISPATCH",
  "rideId": "ride-uuid-456",
  "dispatchedAt": "2026-02-28T08:00:30Z",
  "expiresIn": 15
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "RIDE_CANCELLED",
  "rideId": "ride-uuid-456",
  "reason": "Accepted by another driver"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "DESTINATION_CHANGED",
  "rideId": "ride-uuid-456",
  "newDropoff": {
    "latitude": 23.7461,
    "longitude": 90.3742,
    "address": "Dhanmondi 27, Dhaka"
  },
  "updatedFareEstimate": 420.50,
  "currency": "BDT",
  "changedAt": "2026-02-28T08:18:00Z"
}
```

Upon receiving a `RIDE_DISPATCH` event, the driver app should immediately call `GET /drivers/{driverId}/ride-requests` to fetch full ride details.
Upon receiving a `DESTINATION_CHANGED` event, the driver app should call `GET /rides/{rideId}/route` to fetch the updated route.
